definitions.explanation: The state of not wearing a hat or cap. Often noted as a contrast to the norm when headwear would be expected.

examples.english: I went outside without a hat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{真夏|まなつ}→真夏：27793_manatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{無帽|むぼう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}→熱中症：08330_necchuushou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Walking without a hat in midsummer makes it easy to get heatstroke.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無帽|むぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦{整列|せいれつ}していた→整列する：20154_seiretsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The soldiers were lined up bareheaded.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) and {帽|ぼう} (hat, cap). A somewhat formal or literary word. In everyday conversation, ⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶっていない→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧ (not wearing a hat) is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無帽|むぼう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧: to go out without a hat
- {無帽|むぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま: remaining bareheaded

USAGE:
More commonly seen in written descriptions, military contexts, and formal regulations (such as school dress codes specifying when hats are required). Occasionally used in literary descriptions of characters.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧なし: without a hat — colloquial equivalent
- ⟦{無謀|むぼう}→無謀：13423_mubou⟧: reckless — a homophone with completely different meaning; do not confuse
